name: Supreme Watersports
summary: A Holetown watersports team, all born and raised in Barbados, running jet skis, tube rides, water skiing and wakeboarding, with 30 minute lessons for first-timers. One hour boat cruises follow the coast from the west to the south, and snorkel trips visit the reef and turtles. Guests staying on the west coast are picked up and dropped off at no charge.
standouts: Team born and raised in Barbados
Waterskiing and wakeboarding lessons from qualified instructors
Free pick up and drop off for hotels and residences on the west coast
Activities booked and paid for on the operator's own website

checkNotes: WordPress and WooCommerce site; each activity is its own product page with Add to cart, so the product pages are the booking links. Prices on the pages are shown as $ only; the terms and conditions say 'All payments shall be in United States Dollars', and the store's currency setting is USD. Terms also say 'All booking are final and cancellation is not allowed', payment by Visa, Mastercard, cash or bank transfer, and that the services are intended for users 18 and over, with minors needing a parent or guardian's permission and supervision. The home page 'BOOK US TODAY!' buttons point to https://dianew130.sg-host.com/activities/, a hosting staging address, not the live domain. The terms page spells the domain as supremewatersportsbarabdos.com (typo). Product pages were updated between December 2024 and March 2026, so the business looks active. The site links a YouTube channel (Supreme Watersports Barbados) whose public feed has no videos. Pick up: free for hotels and residences on the west coast; others can take a taxi to Holetown or have one arranged at extra cost. The site also offers drop off to any destination in Barbados on request.
